verdict.rationale: Reclaim ships an AI chat assistant, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to external MCP servers. The probes show only that Reclaim runs its own first-party MCP server at mcp.reclaim.ai, which is the server role and a different story, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
